Create the file case_120.inp in the working directory using the exact text shown inside the code block of the Input deck section, excluding the ```inp and ``` fence markers.
Do not change the physics or any numerical values in the input deck.
Run CalculiX with the command `ccx -i case_120` if it works, otherwise run `ccx case_120`.
Record the exact ccx command used in the notes field.
Check the case_120.sta file for a successful termination line such as 'JOB COMPLETED'.
Write a results.json file in the working directory with the exact schema provided.
Set the solver field to "calculix".
Set the case_id field to "case_120".
Set the status field to "success" if the .sta file indicates successful termination, otherwise set it to "error".
Set the artifacts field to an empty array.
Set the ccx_version field to the version string obtained from `ccx -v`, or the closest equivalent if that command is not available.
Set the notes field to the exact ccx command used, and if the run failed, also include the error message and the name of the file that indicated the failure.
